title: User Guide formatting and rewrite
intro: The guide's new formatting (icons, keycaps, links, faint dividers, spacing) and the rewritten pages.
Answers save in this browser as you go. Hit Download results at the end and send me the file.

groups.title: Drawing
groups.need: How these look can't be tested outside the game. Parsing is pinned by Core tests.

steps.text: Run `make build`, reload Vista, open the User Guide with ?.

steps.action: Open the Edit page (under Modes) and look at its top row table
steps.expect: Each row starts with the same icon the real button shows, in the text colour, lined up with the text.
Keys sit in small rounded boxes. Ctrl + Space shows two boxes with a plain + between them. No box is cut in half by a line wrap.
/vista release is muted text with no box.

steps.action: Look at any page with sections, such as Playing a track
steps.expect: Each section heading has a faint line above it with some space either side. The page title has none.

steps.action: Read a page top to bottom
steps.expect: Headings, paragraphs, lists and tables are spaced so the page reads as sections, not one block.

steps.action: Look at Getting started's Where next list
steps.expect: Modes, Tracks and points and Hotkeys are underlined in the accent colour. Bold control names are the accent colour with no underline.
The cursor turns into a hand.
The Hotkeys page shows, and Hotkeys is highlighted in the tree.

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom of Playlist, then click a link on another page that goes somewhere long, such as Tracks and points' Timing link
steps.expect: The new page opens scrolled to the top.

groups.title: Reading
groups.need: The rewrite cut every page to the new GUIDES.md rules. Read each page for length, clarity and anything wrong.

steps.action: Read Getting started, Modes, Edit and Live
Read Tracks and points and its three sub-pages
Read Timing and its three sub-pages
Read Aim and its three sub-pages
Read Scenes and anchors, Playlist, The Camera window and Hotkeys
